summary: Brian Perri, 38, of Fort Collins went missing after summiting Mount Meeker on June 30; a 22.5-square-mile search used ground teams, dogs, helicopters and UAS; body found July 28 in steep terrain southwest of the summit
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR, Flight for Life, Larimer County SAR
notes: Reported missing July 5 after texting a summit photo June 30; cause of death not stated in opened sources; county not verified MERGE run469: NPS July-31-2018 recovery release appended (body found by ranger responding to the separate Keplinger Couloir SPOT activation; 25-40 ft tumbling fall SW of Mount Meeker summit). | run-831 NPT corroboration URL appended (parent-opened). | run-831 NPT corroboration URL appended (parent-opened). 2026-09-22: merged LCSAR FB post permalink (LCSAR FB post: search for Brian Perri ongoing (Mount Meeker).).
